schema.sql: SELECT table_schema,table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema IN ('fab10','fab11','fab12','fab13') ORDER BY table_schema,table_name,ordinal_position

model_etch_counts.sql: SELECT area,COUNT(*) AS rows,COUNT(DISTINCT toolgroup) AS distinct_toolgroups FROM fab10.toolgroups_fab10 WHERE area ILIKE '%etch%' GROUP BY area ORDER BY area

model_metrology_counts.sql: SELECT area,COUNT(*) AS rows FROM fab10.toolgroups_fab10 WHERE area ILIKE '%Met%' GROUP BY area ORDER BY area

model_metrology_routes.sql: SELECT 'route_product_3_fab10' AS source_table,area,COUNT(*) AS rows FROM fab10.route_product_3_fab10 WHERE area ILIKE '%Met%' GROUP BY area UNION ALL SELECT 'route_product_4_fab10',area,COUNT(*) FROM fab10.route_product_4_fab10 WHERE area ILIKE '%Met%' GROUP BY area ORDER BY source_table,area
